observations: Photo 0: a cast aluminium engine assembly with a helical drive gear and bronze-coloured bearing journal, several 12-point bolts and long threaded mounting bolts through it, lying on an oily concrete floor; part of an engine block is behind it.
Photo 1: the same assembly held in a hand, showing two shaft ends with bearings in a housing and long mounting bolts.
Photo 2: the underside or side of the housing with a pickup or pump body, bolts and a cast mark reading '5-B'; no part number or brand is readable.
The shape matches an engine oil pump combined with balance shafts, the module that bolts under the crankcase of an inline four-cylinder engine.
All three photos carry a dealer watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'UCHENNA'.
The aluminium is clean with light surface marks; no visible cracks, but gear teeth wear and the internals cannot be judged.

identity.kind: engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly (used car part)
read_from: photo 0 gear and balance shaft housing
photo 2 pump body, cast mark '5-B' only

claims.claim: Engine oil pump balance shaft assembly
claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a housing with a drive gear, twin shaft ends and a pump body that match an oil pump and balance shaft module.

claims.claim: For Toyota cars like Camry (2018 to present), RAV4 and others
claims.evidence: No Toyota mark, part number or engine code is readable in any photo; only a cast '5-B' in photo 2.

risks.risk: The part does not fit the claimed Toyota engines (wrong engine family or a different maker).
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the cast or stamped part number on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: As a used oil pump balance shaft assembly of unconfirmed fitment.

risks.risk: Worn gears, bearings or pump rotor, or low oil pressure output.
risks.proof: Close-ups of the gear teeth and the pump rotor with the cover off, and a clip spinning the shafts by hand.

risks.risk: Cracked housing or bent shafts not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: A clear photo of each side of the assembly on a clean surface.

risks.risk: Missing pieces such as the pickup strainer, gasket or full bolt set.
risks.proof: A flat-lay photo of everything included.
risks.if_unproven: As the housing and shafts only.

proof_requests: A sharp close-up of the part number on the housing.
A photo of the engine code on the block it came from.
Close-ups of the gear teeth and pump rotor.
A flat-lay of the full assembly and every piece included on a clean surface.
A fresh photo with a handwritten note bearing today's date in shot.
response.reason: The photos show a used engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly, so it can be priced by type at its worst case as worn with unconfirmed fitment; the Toyota fitment is the seller's word only until a part number is shown.
